carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.d: Harrell leaves Greenville after going 19-19 and takes over a Stanford team still searching for its first win. Per a source, the pitch was a long runway and a clean slate, a contrast with a Pirates job that now sits with Pirate_flag.

quote.text: He wanted a place where nobody expects a miracle by October. He can build it his way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561119626battle.h: Oklahoma Edges Ahead for Five-Star CB Wilds, but Ole Miss Is Still Pushing
561119626battle.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] has a slim lead for [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]], with [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] right behind and Texas Tech lurking. His dealbreaker is championship contention, so Oklahoma's fourth-down loss to Missouri won't help the pitch.

quote.text: He wants to know who's winning titles. Everything else is secondary.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561121675battle.h: Missouri holds the edge for I. Favre, but Michigan won't back down
561121675battle.d: [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] cares about conference prestige above all, and that has Missouri and Michigan both pitching hard. Indiana is still in the mix after its six-interception game against Delaware. Expect a busy week.

quote.text: He keeps asking about the league first and everything else second.
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

561120536battle.h: Oklahoma clings to a lead for C. Longo, with Missouri crashing the party
561120536battle.d: Oklahoma has the advantage for the five-star receiver, but the loss to Missouri has made the pitch harder. Notre Dame's sloppy loss to Indiana also stung. Brand exposure is the dealbreaker for [[r:561120536|C. Longo]], and official visits could decide it.

quote.text: He watched that Missouri game. Everybody around him did.
quote.by: a person familiar with Longo's thinking

561121938battle.h: Oklahoma barely ahead for K. Simonson as Tennessee and Texas Tech charge
561121938battle.d: Three programs are within shouting distance of [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]], and conference prestige is what he cares about most. Oklahoma has the slim lead. Rival staffs say one more strong week could swing it.

quote.text: It's a three-horse race and everybody knows it.

557727130:underpaid.h: E. Udoh is playing like a star and getting paid like a backup
557727130:underpaid.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver making nothing in NIL, while similar players get around 100K. Agents and collectives have noticed that gap, and it tends to close in the portal.

quote.text: If his camp starts shopping him, he'll have offers within a day.
quote.by: an agent familiar with the market

561121140battle.h: Texas Tech and Texas A&M are in a dogfight for E. Wolf
561121140battle.d: Texas Tech has a slight lead for the five-star corner, but [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] has closed hard, and Texas hasn't gone away. [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] wants a clear path to playing time, and each staff is selling one.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's starting, not where he's competing.

557718419:underpaid.h: Somebody will pay I. Rashed. Could BYU be the team?
557718419:underpaid.d: [[p:557718419|I.Rashed]] is an 88-overall safety making 65K, while similar players get around 140K. A portal move would start a bidding war, and [[t:832438288|BYU]] is being mentioned as a possible destination.

quote.text: Safeties like him almost never reach the portal. If he does, it's chaos.

557718710:underpaid.h: Wake Forest's Boger is a bargain for now, and rival collectives know it
557718710:underpaid.d: [[p:557718710|D.Boger]] is an 85-overall quarterback making 65K while similar players command far more. Rival collectives are reportedly circling [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]].

quote.text: He's underpaid, and everyone knows it.

831914776:upset.h: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] survives [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] in a one-point thriller
831914776:upset.d: The Broncos took the one-point win and left the Sun Devils with a lot to answer for. Arizona State was the better-ranked team and left with the worse result. A slide in the polls is coming, and a few Tempe boosters are already grumbling.

quote.text: We don't care who's ranked where. We showed up and made one more play than they did.

831914302:4th:832438379.h: [[t:832438379|Stanford]] goes for it four times, and the fan base explodes
831914302:4th:832438379.d: Three failed fourth-down tries against [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] have turned the Stanford message boards into a bonfire. Inside the building, a source says the players liked the aggression, but the staff is hearing it from donors.

quote.text: I trusted my guys. We came up short.

831914196:comeback.h: [[t:832438411|Western Kentucky]] erases a 21-point hole to stun [[t:832438402|UTEP]] in overtime
831914196:comeback.d: UTEP looked finished-in-reverse, up big after three quarters, then watched Western Kentucky win the fourth 21-0 and take it in overtime, 48-42. A source says the UTEP sideline got very quiet before the extra period.

quote.text: Nobody panicked. Somebody on the bench just said 'one play at a time,' and we believed it.

831914166:int:557725326.h: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]]'s four picks leave [[t:832438398|USC]] with plenty of questions
831914166:int:557725326.d: Four interceptions and no touchdowns against [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] put the USC quarterback in a spotlight he didn't want. A source says staffers were stunned by how many of the throws were forced.

quote.text: He kept trying to win the game on one throw. You can't do that against a team that is waiting for it.
quote.by: a source close to the USC program

831914227:upset.d: Missouri's 19-17 loss in Boulder shreds a ranking and complicates its recruiting pitch. Both [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] and [[r:561120536|C. Longo]] have Missouri high on their lists, and rival staffs will make sure they hear about it.

quote.text: Every rival is going to say Missouri is not who they said they were. That's the recruiting pitch against them this week.

831914832:flags:832438349.d: Eleven penalties for 95 yards kept Nevada from ever getting comfortable against the Buckeyes. Tuddy_roosevelt gets a comfortable win after the Nebraska stumble, and a source says Nevada's practice this week will be 'ugly'.

quote.text: We gave them every inch and then some. That's on us, not them.

831914166:ot.h: [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] edges [[t:832438398|USC]] in overtime, adding to its growing résumé
831914166:ot.d: Syracuse took the extra period 6-0 and left USC wondering how it let one slip away. After last week's win over Texas, the Orange are no longer a surprise, and recruits are noticing.

quote.text: People keep saying they got lucky. After two weeks, that stops being a story.

831914237:4th:832438321.h: [[t:832438321|Iowa State]] bets on fourth down, loses to [[t:832438320|Iowa]]
831914237:4th:832438321.d: Two failed fourth-down tries cost Iowa State, and the analytics crowd and the fan base are now at odds. A source says the head coach stood by the decisions in the locker room, but boosters are not as calm.

quote.text: The numbers say go. The scoreboard says punt. The fans are going to remember the scoreboard.

831914483:pass:557723567.d: Griggs threw for 328 yards in Washington's 48-34 win, and Tennessee's secondary spent the day chasing him. A source says the Vols staff has been sour about their coverage breakdowns all week.

quote.text: We knew what was coming and still couldn't stop it. That's what hurts.

831914573:int:557718221.d: Yoder's rough day, with only a single touchdown to offset four interceptions, was a showcase for Ole Miss's secondary. Five-star corner [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]] saw it, and a source says the Rebels' staff made sure he did.

quote.text: Every corner wants to play where the ball finds you. That's Oxford right now.
quote.by: a source close to the Ole Miss program

831914041:int:557727686.d: Holloway put up two touchdowns, but his three interceptions decided it for Mississippi State. After a six-interception week for A. Renda, the Bulldogs' defense gave the offense a much-needed bounce-back.

quote.text: It felt good to be on the other end of it for once.

831914703:int:557725879.d: Waggoner's long afternoon ended with three picks and a loss for the Bears. A source says the offense had no answer once BYU started sitting on his throws.

quote.text: He kept trying to squeeze it in. At some point you have to take the checkdown.
quote.by: a source close to the Baylor program

831914466:4th:832438351.h: [[t:832438351|New Mexico State]]'s fourth-down gambles backfire against [[t:832438372|Sam Houston]]
831914466:4th:832438351.d: Three turnovers on downs turned a close game into a loss for New Mexico State. A source says the punter spent most of the day on the sideline in disbelief.

quote.text: Coach believes in the plan. Doesn't mean the plan worked.

831914342:blowout.d: 627 yards made this a layup for agerm40's group. A source says I. Stockton's workload was light, but other programs keep an eye on him, and the film still shows a strong running game.

quote.text: We just wanted to keep the tempo up. The run game was setting everything up.

831914804:shutout.d: The Aggies held FCS Northwest to no yards and no first downs. A source says A&M's staff used the day to rest starters and polish their pitch to [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]].

quote.text: That's the kind of defense that gets a corner excited.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas A&M program

831914574:pass:557723721.h: [[p:557723721|B.Beaver]] shreds a defense for 460 yards in LSU's romp
831914574:pass:557723721.d: Beaver completed 31 of 38 with no interceptions in a 56-17 LSU win. A source says opposing coordinators were already studying his film before the game ended.

quote.text: He saw everything before it happened. It was a clinic.

831914444:pass:557717471.h: [[p:557717471|P.Harris]] throws five touchdowns as Louisiana rolls, 45-6
831914444:pass:557717471.d: Harris threw for 317 yards and a lopsided win. A source says Louisiana's coaches are quietly pleased with how efficient the passing game looked and a few scouts took notes.

quote.text: When the protection is that good, the throws are easy.

831914491:rivalry.h: [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] wins the Backyard Brawl on the last possession
831914491:rivalry.d: Pitt held on in a game that went to the wire, as these always do. A source says the Panthers' sideline erupted while the other side stood stunned.

quote.text: It doesn't matter how it looks. We won, and nobody can take that from us.

831914134:blowout.d: TCU piled up 609 yards in a rout, and Air Force's film session will be unpleasant. A source says Air Force's staff privately expected a tougher fight.

quote.text: We just couldn't get off the field. It was one long afternoon.

831914253:shutout.d: Liberty managed just 180 yards and 7 first downs against Auburn. A source says the Tigers' staff used the blowout to see depth players and rebuild confidence.

quote.text: That's the kind of game that tells you the work is paying off.

831914645:def:557717838.h: [[p:557717838|R.Levine]] racks up three sacks in Michigan's 49-21 win
831914645:def:557717838.d: Levine finished with five tackles, three of them for loss, and turned the opposing backfield into his office. A source says NFL scouts left impressed.

quote.text: He wins before the snap. You can see the tackle wondering what to do.

831914627:def:557726041.h: [[p:557726041|T.Sanders]] picks off [[t:832438324|Kansas]] twice in Virginia's win
831914627:def:557726041.d: Sanders added four tackles to his two interceptions as Virginia won 34-24. A source says Kansas's staff spent the week warning receivers about his instincts.

quote.text: I just read the quarterback's eyes. They kept telling me where it was going.

831914105:flags:832438387.h: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] flagged 12 times in loss to [[t:832438311|Fresno State]]
831914105:flags:832438387.d: Twelve penalties for 86 yards made the loss an ugly one. It's a bad look as [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] weighs the Red Raiders, and a source says rivals are already bringing it up.

quote.text: Discipline is the first thing a recruit asks about. That game didn't help.

831914725:3rd:832438375.h: [[t:832438375|SMU]] converts just two of 13 third downs in loss to [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]]
831914725:3rd:832438375.d: Drives kept dying at the worst time for SMU. A source says the Mustangs' offense looked tentative, and the stall won't help the pitch to recruits like B. Bouye.

quote.text: Every drive felt like third-and-long. We never found a rhythm.

831914560:rec:557718616.d: Babers needed only four catches to rack up 135 yards and three scores, including a 60-yarder. A source says Washington State's corners were still arguing about the coverage on the sideline.

quote.text: Once he got a step, there was no catching him.

561124002battle.h: Clemson leads for C. Faulkner, but Michigan is still working
561124002battle.d: The shutout of Western Michigan gave Clemson a boost with [[r:561124002|C. Faulkner]], a five-star who wants to play right away. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has not conceded, and Notre Dame is lurking behind both.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the depth chart. Whoever shows him a real role wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557711446:buried.h: Sophomore Punter T.Gayton Is Too Good to Sit and Could Leave
557711446:buried.d: [[p:557711446|T.Gayton]] is an 82-overall sophomore punter with no snaps in three games. Special teams coaches elsewhere would start him tomorrow, so a transfer feels more likely than not.

quote.text: He's good enough to start almost anywhere, and he knows it. Sitting is going to wear on him.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557715137:buried.h: J.Pyke Is Stuck at No. 3 at Notre Dame and May Not Wait
557715137:buried.d: [[p:557715137|J.Pyke]] is an 83-overall junior guard with no snaps in three games, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has him third on the depth chart. The portal could look appealing, and it comes while the Irish are selling playing time to recruits.

quote.text: He thought he'd be playing by now. Three games without a snap is a long time for a guy with that rating.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713073:buried.h: H.Wonnum Is Too Good to Sit, and Transfer Chatter Is Starting
557713073:buried.d: [[p:557713073|H.Wonnum]] is an 83-overall sophomore middle linebacker with only 11 snaps in three games. Programs shopping the portal for linebackers would start him right away.

quote.text: Guys like him don't stay on the bench for long. Somebody will offer him a starting job.

831914863:ot.h: James Madison escapes Akron in overtime after a game that wouldn't break
831914863:ot.d: [[t:832438323|James Madison]] needed the extra period to get past [[t:832438273|Akron]], 16-13, taking overtime 6-3. Per a source close to the Dukes, the sideline was tight long before the finish.

quote.text: We didn't play pretty, but we found a way. That's a good sign in September.
quote.by: A source close to the James Madison program

831914858:shutout.h: Troy's defense blanks Central Michigan and sends a message to the Sun Belt
831914858:shutout.d: [[t:832438389|Troy]] pitched a shutout against [[t:832438290|Central Michigan]], which gained 356 yards and 9 first downs and still never got on the board. Moving the ball without scoring is a coaching problem, and Chippewas staffers know it.

quote.text: They gave up yards between the 20s and nothing when it counted. That's a defense that knows who it is.
quote.by: A rival staffer who studied the film

831914843:rec:557715702.h: T. Pitts ran wild on Bowling Green, bracket coverage and all
831914843:rec:557715702.d: [[p:557715702|T.Pitts]] finished with 8 catches, 216 yards and a touchdown against [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]], which tried to bracket him and got nowhere. Expect his name to come up in bigger rooms soon.

quote.text: You can double him all day. Then he just goes and takes the ball away from you.
quote.by: A scout who attended the game

557712567:fit.h: Stanford's pass defense could push safety Carraway toward the portal
557712567:fit.d: Stanford's pass defense is ranked 126th of 138, and [[p:557712567|D.Carraway]] is an 85-overall hybrid safety who wants to play for a winner. Teams are watching to see what he decides.

quote.text: He's a good player stuck in a bad pass defense. That's a transfer waiting to happen.

557712191:fit.h: Penn State's sack problem could cost agerm40 edge rusher Yates
557712191:fit.d: [[p:557712191|R.Yates]] is an 83-overall power rusher on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 120th in sacks. A source says he's weighing his options, and agerm40 has to make a case for staying.

quote.text: He wants to rush the passer, and he isn't getting chances.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557717563:fit.h: Stanford's offensive struggles could cost it lineman D. Hilliman
557717563:fit.d: [[p:557717563|D.Hilliman]], an 81-overall raw strength guard, plays for a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] offense ranked 118th of 138 in total yardage. Per a source, he's started to wonder if a better situation is out there.

quote.text: Linemen want to be part of something that moves the ball. Right now that's not Stanford.
quote.by: A source close to the program

831914232:4th:832438360.h: Oklahoma's Fourth-Down Aggression Hands Missouri the Win and Fans Boil Over
831914232:4th:832438360.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] kept the offense on the field four times against [[t:832438344|Missouri]] and cashed in once. Three failed tries later, the boards are demanding answers, and a few boosters reportedly want them too.

quote.text: You can be bold, but you can't be bold from your own side of the field every time.
quote.by: a source close to the Oklahoma program

831914576:upset.h: Minnesota Hammers No. 23 Tennessee in Yardage and Sends the Poll Voters Scrambling
831914576:upset.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] dominated the stat sheet against [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], and the Vols are lucky the result was this close. Expect a tumble in the rankings and some uncomfortable film study in Knoxville.

quote.text: We got pushed around for most of the day. That's not a ranked team's performance.
quote.by: a Tennessee player, speaking on background

831914722:int:557727898.h: Crisp's Six-Interception Disaster Leaves Delaware Searching for Answers Against Indiana
831914722:int:557727898.d: W. Crisp threw for a touchdown, but the six picks were what everyone left talking about. [[t:832438298|Delaware]] now has a quarterback question, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]'s defensive backs have a strong tape to hand recruits.

quote.text: He kept trying to make the one big play. The game wasn't asking him for it.

831914340:ot.h: Texas A&M Survives Florida State in Overtime Thriller
831914340:ot.d: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] won it 26-23 after taking the extra period 6-3. [[t:832438310|Florida State]] had chances to put it away and didn't, and the sideline mood afterward was tense.

quote.text: We let a game we should have closed go into overtime. That's on all of us.

831914040:int:557723835.h: Bradley's Three Picks Overshadow Appalachian State's Loss at Nebraska
831914040:int:557723835.d: B. Bradley moved the ball but couldn't hold onto it, and [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] took advantage. [[t:832438275|Appalachian State]] will be looking at its quarterback decisions all week.

quote.text: He's got the arm. He just has to stop forcing it into traffic.

831914054:int:557718961.h: Horan's Three Picks Sink Oregon State in the Civil War
831914054:int:557718961.d: D. Horan threw two touchdowns, but three interceptions cost [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] the game against [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. Coaches are reportedly frustrated by his decisions under pressure.

quote.text: He's too talented to keep making the same mistake.
quote.by: a source close to the Oregon State program

831914576:ot.h: Minnesota Needs Overtime to Beat Tennessee Despite Controlling the Game
831914576:ot.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] won 33-30 after taking the extra period 13-10. The Gophers should have won by more, but [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] refused to go away. Some Minnesota fans are grumbling about game management.

quote.text: Winning is winning, but we left points on the field.

831914539:rivalry.h: Washington Makes the Apple Cup a Blowout Against Washington State
831914539:rivalry.d: [[t:832438408|Washington]] won 45-3 and left [[t:832438409|Washington State]] with plenty to answer for. Cougar fans want changes, and the rumor mill is already churning.

quote.text: That one stings for a long time.

831914298:4th:832438334.h: Marshall's Fourth-Down Gambles Backfire Against Massachusetts
831914298:4th:832438334.d: [[t:832438334|Marshall]] failed on three of four fourth-down tries and lost to [[t:832438396|Massachusetts]]. The head coach's aggressiveness has fans calling for a more conservative approach.

quote.text: Some of those were punt situations. Period.

831914600:4th:832438286.h: Bowling Green's Fourth-Down Tries Cost It Against USF
831914600:4th:832438286.d: [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]] converted two of four fourth downs but turned it over on downs twice and fell to [[t:832438399|USF]]. Players backed the aggressiveness in the locker room, but fans are less forgiving.

quote.text: We believe in the call. We just have to execute it.

831914348:int:557727365.h: Colorado's Secondary Feasts on Emanuel With Four Interceptions
831914348:int:557727365.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] turned C. Emanuel's afternoon into a nightmare, holding him to 83 yards. His offense never found a rhythm, and questions about his future are starting to surface.

quote.text: Every ball he threw felt like it was ours.

831914425:pass:557716196.h: Connors Torches Purdue as TCU Rolls to a 59-10 Win
831914425:pass:557716196.d: L. Connors threw for 404 yards and two touchdowns without an interception. TCU's 59-10 win over [[t:832438368|Purdue]] left the Boilermakers' secondary with a long week ahead.

quote.text: He was on a different level out there.

831914833:def:557722165.h: Toombs Wrecks Everything With Four Sacks in Syracuse's 44-3 Rout
831914833:def:557722165.d: R. Toombs was in the backfield all afternoon: six tackles, five for loss. After Syracuse's upset of Texas earlier this year, the defensive line is getting national attention, and so is its star.

quote.text: You can't block him one-on-one. We tried everything.

831914243:pass:557723049.h: Mississippi State Falls to Southern Miss as Stewart Throws for 499 Yards
831914243:pass:557723049.d: H. Stewart threw for 499 yards and three touchdowns in Southern Mississippi's 48-45 win over [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]]. A.Renda's six-interception game earlier in the year was bad, but this loss may sting more.

quote.text: We gave up too many chunk plays. It's not complicated.
quote.by: a source close to the Mississippi State program

831914014:ot.h: Texas State Edges Rival in 53-51 Overtime Thriller
831914014:ot.d: [[t:832438386|Texas State]] held on 53-51 after taking the extra period 12-10. Both defenses took a beating, and both sets of coaches will have plenty to clean up.

quote.text: Nobody's going to enjoy the film from that one.

831914122:ot.d: [[t:832438335|Maryland]] won a tight one after taking the extra period 9-6. It wasn't pretty, and the sidelines were tense throughout.

quote.text: We'll take it, but we know we have to be better.

831914679:def:557723866.h: Bright's Two Picks of BYU Aren't Enough in Defeat
831914679:def:557723866.d: M. Bright intercepted [[t:832438288|BYU]] twice and finished with two tackles in a loss. Scouts took notice, and NFL-minded evaluators are paying attention.

quote.text: He's the one guy who showed up. It's a shame.
quote.by: a scout who attended the game

831914752:ot.h: Northern Illinois Edges Middle Tennessee in Overtime
831914752:ot.d: [[t:832438355|Northern Illinois]] won 30-27 after taking the extra period 10-7. [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]] had its chances but couldn't finish, and the postgame mood was bleak.

quote.text: We had it. We just didn't close.

831914510:rec:557723759.h: Folk Hauls In 13 Catches and Two TDs Against Georgia Tech
831914510:rec:557723759.d: D. Folk put up 188 yards even though [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] tried bracketing him. Programs with bigger names are reportedly asking about his eligibility and his future.

quote.text: We doubled him, and he still won. What else can you do?

831914328:rivalry.h: Utah Takes the Battle of the Brothers, 33-17
831914328:rivalry.d: [[t:832438400|Utah]] won comfortably over [[t:832438401|Utah State]] and keeps bragging rights for another year. Aggies fans wanted more fight.

quote.text: We had no answers once they got going.

831914420:pass:557725905.h: Reynolds Throws Five TDs as Wisconsin Dominates Missouri State
831914420:pass:557725905.d: T. Reynolds was nearly perfect, and Wisconsin won 49-0. [[t:832438345|Missouri State]] had no answer, and the locker room afterward was quiet.

quote.text: That was the cleanest game I've seen from a quarterback this year.

831914431:pass:557713591.h: Pena's 404 Yards Aren't Enough as Arkansas State Wins 41-40
831914431:pass:557713591.d: D. Pena threw for 404 yards and four touchdowns, but his team lost by a point to [[t:832438279|Arkansas State]]. His one interception will haunt him.

quote.text: He did everything but win. That one's going to stick with him.
quote.by: a source close to Pena's program

831913996:shutout.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] smothered [[t:832438412|Western Michigan]], which managed just 237 yards. P. Coburn, the recruit torn between Clemson and Alabama, may have taken note of what a dominant defense looks like.

quote.text: That's the kind of defense a recruit wants to play on.

831914060:shutout.h: North Dakota State Shuts Out Sacramento State, 17-0
831914060:shutout.d: [[t:832438353|North Dakota State]] held [[t:832438371|Sacramento State]] to 125 yards. The Bison defense looked unblockable, and the Hornets looked lost.

quote.text: We could not get anything going.

831914111:shutout.h: North Carolina Posts Shutout Against Kennesaw State
831914111:shutout.d: [[t:832438352|North Carolina]]'s defense held [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] to 296 yards and 13 first downs. The Owls' offense never found its footing.

quote.text: Our guys were flying around all day.

831914416:shutout.h: Michigan Blanks Central Michigan Again in a Familiar Story
831914416:shutout.d: [[t:832438339|Michigan]] held [[t:832438290|Central Michigan]] to 196 yards. After Troy shut the Chippewas out last week, the offense has a long list of questions.

quote.text: Two weeks in a row, that's a real problem.

831914653:def:557716215.h: Barkow Records Four Sacks as FIU Edges Florida Atlantic, 23-21
831914653:def:557716215.d: M. Barkow had five tackles, four for loss, in a two-point win over [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]]. His pass rush decided the game, and the Owls had no answer.

quote.text: He lived in our backfield. We couldn't slow him down.

831914793:flags:832438347.h: NC State Sunk by 11 Penalties in Loss to Virginia
831914793:flags:832438347.d: [[t:832438347|NC State]] was flagged 11 times for 71 yards and lost to [[t:832438405|Virginia]]. Discipline will be the theme of practice, and a few players reportedly didn't love the officiating or the sideline's reaction to it.

quote.text: We beat ourselves. There's no excuse.

831914309:3rd:832438327.h: Kent State Goes 2-for-16 on Third Down in Loss to Rutgers
831914309:3rd:832438327.d: [[t:832438327|Kent State]] couldn't sustain drives against [[t:832438370|Rutgers]]. The offensive coordinator is hearing about it from fans, and players weren't happy with the play-calling.

quote.text: We were behind the chains all day. It was frustrating.

561123015commit.h: Miami lands No. 28 overall R. Reiff after statement win
561123015commit.d: The 62-6 rout of [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] hit at the perfect time. [[r:561123015|R. Reiff]] wanted a power-conference stage, and Miami gave him one.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561124332commit.h: K. Breeze keeps it close to home and picks Clemson
561124332commit.d: The four-star athlete from Cumming liked what he saw from Clemson's 37-0 win over [[t:832438412|Western Michigan]]. Staying close to family sealed it, per people around the program. [[r:561124332|K. Breeze]] chose the Tigers.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

561123224commit.h: Tennessee gets a recruiting win with four-star athlete C. Eddy
561123224commit.d: A rough start to the season didn't scare off [[r:561123224|C. Eddy]]. He wanted the national spotlight and a short drive from Reidsville, and Tennessee gave him both.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

557718464:underpaid.h: Rival collectives start circling Texas Tech corner E. Kight
557718464:underpaid.d: [[p:557718464|E.Kight]] is a 90-overall corner making 70K, while similar players get around 155K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has deep NIL pockets, so a raise could still keep him. Other collectives are already picking up the phone.

quote.text: That number doesn't match the tape. Everybody in the portal world has noticed.

557717339:sinking.h: M. Allgeier is wasted on a 1-2 Tennessee team
557717339:sinking.d: [[p:557717339|M.Allgeier]] is a 91-overall junior quarterback on a Tennessee team that's 1-2. Contenders have noticed, and some are already planning around the possibility that he enters the portal.

quote.text: He's a top-shelf quarterback on a team that's gone sideways. Everyone knows his name.

557712739:buried.h: J. Morey has 88-overall talent and zero snaps. Is a transfer next?
557712739:buried.d: [[p:557712739|J.Morey]] is an 88-overall junior guard who hasn't played a snap in three games. A team in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and his patience could be running out.

quote.text: He's too good to stand on the sideline. He knows that and so do we.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713542:buried.h: Stuck behind Allgeier, S. Soto may not wait around at Tennessee
557713542:buried.d: [[p:557713542|S.Soto]] is an 88-overall sophomore quarterback who has taken just two snaps in three games. He's stuck at No. 2 on the depth chart, and starting jobs elsewhere could tempt him.

quote.text: He wants to play. Sitting for another year isn't in the plan.

557719215:buried.h: R. Hardy is too good to share snaps. Is a transfer coming?
557719215:buried.d: [[p:557719215|R.Hardy]] is an 88-overall sophomore edge rusher who has played 44 snaps in three games. Staffs think he's a starter anywhere else, and they're watching his usage closely.

quote.text: A guy like that doesn't stay in a rotation for long.

557717314:sinking.h: E. DaSilva deserves better than 1-2, and contenders know it
557717314:sinking.d: [[p:557717314|E.DaSilva]] is a 90-overall junior edge rusher on a Tennessee team that's 1-2. If he enters the portal, it will be the story of the offseason, and teams are already preparing offers.

quote.text: Every contender with a pass-rush need has his number saved.

557715938:sinking.h: Texas has a problem: J. Duggan is too good for a 1-2 team
557715938:sinking.d: [[p:557715938|J.Duggan]] is a 91-overall junior receiver stuck on a Texas team that's 1-2 after the Syracuse upset. If he enters the portal, his phone will light up immediately.

quote.text: A bad season in Austin makes every other offer look better.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557715517:struggling.h: E. Marquez rates 88 but has no catches to show for it
557715517:struggling.d: [[p:557715517|E.Marquez]] has no catches and no yards in three games. That isn't good enough for an 88-overall receiver, and his coaches may start looking at the portal for a replacement.

quote.text: The ratings only buy you so much patience.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724371:struggling.h: Oklahoma may be ready to move on from kicker J. McSwain
557724371:struggling.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] is ranked, and [[p:557724371|J.McSwain]] is just 1-of-5 on field goals. An 86-overall kicker can't do that for a team with title hopes, and the staff may shop the portal.

quote.text: Nobody wants to say it out loud, but the kicking game is a real concern.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719687:struggling.h: T.Bada's Quiet Stretch Has Texas Weighing Its Options
557719687:struggling.d: Eight catches for 69 yards in three games is not what an 87-overall receiver is supposed to produce. After the Syracuse upset, [[t:832438384|Texas]] has little patience for anyone whose production has stalled, and the whispers around [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] are getting louder.

quote.text: He's too talented to be this quiet. Something has to change, either the usage or the address.
quote.by: A person close to the Texas program

557718814:struggling.h: R.Cheek Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Production Hasn't Shown It
557718814:struggling.d: Eight catches for 100 yards in three games is thin for an 86-overall receiver. The staff will have to decide this offseason whether [[p:557718814|R.Cheek]] is the answer or a trade chip.

quote.text: The talent is obvious on tape. The impact on Saturdays isn't there yet, and that's the concern.
quote.by: A source close to the program

831914039:fg:557718446.h: Two Missed Kicks Sink Nevada, and N. Gales Is Left to Answer for Them
831914039:fg:557718446.d: [[p:557718446|N.Gales]] went 0-of-2 on field goals in [[t:832438349|Nevada]]'s five-point loss. Two makes would have flipped the result, and the Wolf Pack sideline knew it as the game ended.

quote.text: You don't lose a game on one kick, but you can sure lose it on two. He knows that. Nobody in that building is pretending otherwise.
quote.by: a source close to the Nevada program

557722886:buried.h: Edge rusher Jerman is too good to sit, and sources say he's noticing
557722886:buried.d: An 88-overall edge with only 169 snaps in 12 games, [[p:557722886|L.Jerman]] is getting calls from schools that would start him immediately.

quote.text: He's an 88 sitting on the bench. Every portal team wants that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557712701:buried.h: R.Gado Is Stuck at No. 2 in Columbus, and Patience Is Thinning
557712701:buried.d: The junior tackle is rated 85 overall and played 148 snaps in 12 games. Per a source, [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] has begun asking what his path to a starting job looks like at Ohio State under Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's a starter everywhere except the one place he's playing. That conversation is coming.
quote.by: A source close to the Ohio State program

557712542:buried.h: Arizona State backup Hammer is a 91-overall quarterback who hasn't played
557712542:buried.d: [[p:557712542|J.Hammer]] has zero snaps in 12 games as a sophomore. Portal teams would start him right away, and a source says he's growing impatient.

quote.text: A 91 doesn't sit for another year. He'll find a place to play.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557713589:sinking.h: Penn State's 4-8 season puts star receiver Wilkes on the portal radar
557713589:sinking.d: [[p:557713589|K.Wilkes]] is a 90-overall receiver on a 4-8 team. Contenders will call, and a source says agerm40 knows keeping him won't be easy.

quote.text: Contenders are already texting about him.

557720299:sinking.h: M.Reavis Could Be the Portal's Top Prize If UCLA Can't Win
557720299:sinking.d: A 90-overall sophomore quarterback on a 3-9 team is exactly what portal scouts circle in red. If [[p:557720299|M.Reavis]] enters, he will headline the offseason, and UCLA knows it.

quote.text: Every quarterback-needy program has his tape queued up already.

557712048:sinking.h: J.Landry Deserves Better Than 4-8, and Contenders Are Circling
557712048:sinking.d: The Arkansas junior quarterback is rated 89 overall and attached to a team going nowhere. Every contender knows [[p:557712048|J.Landry]]'s name, and the portal may give him the exit.

quote.text: He's a difference-maker stuck on a team that can't use him. Staffs know that.

557714100:struggling.h: F.McNally Is Rated 85, but 3-of-6 on Field Goals Has Coaches Nervous
557714100:struggling.d: The numbers at kicker are not matching the rating, and sources say the staff is quietly considering a portal search at the position. [[p:557714100|F.McNally]] may have to win the job back.

quote.text: You can live with an off game. Missing half of them, you start looking around.
quote.by: A person familiar with the program's thinking

561121990battle.h: Penn State's thin backfield could be its best pitch for E. Ezeudu
561121990battle.d: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] holds the lead for [[r:561121990|E. Ezeudu]], who wants playing time above all else, and with one returning running back on the roster the path to carries is short. Georgia isn't backing off, and Boise State is still hanging around.

quote.text: He's not looking to hold a clipboard for two years.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561120916battle.h: Wake Forest's open linebacker room gives it a thin edge for D. Pettigrew
561120916battle.d: [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] is clinging to a lead for the four-star SAM, and [[p:557714892|A.Burfict]] graduating opens a spot. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] is right there, and Penn State has made noise late.

quote.text: He's going to go where he sees the field. That's the whole conversation.

561124763battle.h: Indiana holds the edge for K. Ezeala, but Florida State smells an opening
561124763battle.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] leads for the four-star receiver, though conference prestige is his dealbreaker and [[t:832438310|Florida State]] knows it. Tennessee is lurking, and one source says both main contenders plan to empty the playbook this week.

quote.text: Both staffs have been on the phone with the family almost daily.
quote.by: a source familiar with the recruitment

561122986battle.h: USC protects a narrow lead for G. Harris after a bruising week
561122986battle.d: [[t:832438398|USC]] still leads for [[r:561122986|G. Harris]] despite losing to Notre Dame. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has closed in, Indiana is hanging around, and one more strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants a straight answer on snaps, and whoever gives him one wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561119626commit.h: W. Wilds picks Oklahoma, says he's chasing rings
561119626commit.d: [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]] turned down [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] for [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], a program that sold him on title contention and a track record of putting defensive backs in the draft. A source says the pitch never wavered.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561121675commit.h: Missouri lands five-star receiver I. Favre, and the Chicago drive mattered
561121675commit.d: [[t:832438344|Missouri]] beat the field for [[r:561121675|I. Favre]], who wanted a power-conference stage and a short trip home to Chicago. His family reportedly loved the campus visit.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561125724commit.h: Clemson gets its five-star WILL after he watched the South Carolina rout in person
561125724commit.d: [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]] was in the stands for the 50-33 rivalry win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]], and a source says he left that day convinced. [[t:832438293|Clemson]]'s linebacker pipeline to the pros sealed it.

quote.text: That win over South Carolina? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

561121494commit.h: No. 4 overall W. Yeast chooses Georgia after being promised a shot at the job
561121494commit.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] landed one of the biggest names in the class, and a 48-45 shootout win over [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] didn't hurt. Yeast's camp says the coaches were direct about early playing time.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561121140commit.h: Texas A&M steals E. Wolf from Texas, and the Longhorns didn't see it coming
561121140commit.d: [[r:561121140|E. Wolf]] picked [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]], with a vacancy at cornerback after [[p:557713647|J.Levrone]] and a win over No. 8 [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] helping. A source says Texas felt good about its chances.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561120536commit.h: C. Longo goes to Oklahoma for the brand and the spotlight
561120536commit.d: [[r:561120536|C. Longo]] chose [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] over [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] and [[t:832438384|Texas]], and the Sooners' history of producing NFL receivers carried weight with his family. A source says he wanted the biggest stage on offer.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

561121938commit.h: Oklahoma lands five-star QB K. Simonson, and J. Daulton's exit made room
561121938commit.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] won the tug-of-war for [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]], who liked the power-conference stage and an open quarterback room once [[p:557714021|J.Daulton]] leaves. Rival staffs are reportedly already trying to plant doubt.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561120575commit.h: Tennessee lands five-star athlete H. Sumner after the Vanderbilt blowout
561120575commit.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] closed on [[r:561120575|H. Sumner]] on the heels of a 51-10 win over [[t:832438404|Vanderbilt]]. He said he wants a title, and the Vols made that pitch hard.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

561124002commit.h: Michigan beats Clemson and Alabama for C. Faulkner, days after beating Ohio State
561124002commit.d: [[r:561124002|C. Faulkner]] picked [[t:832438339|Michigan]] after the 34-20 win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source says the depth-chart conversation closed it, and the timing won't help Tuddy_roosevelt's mood in Columbus.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561124606commit.h: Texas lands five-star edge M. Lobato, a needed win after the Syracuse sting
561124606commit.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] gets a major pickup in [[r:561124606|M. Lobato]], who bought the Longhorns' record of sending linemen to the NFL. A source says the staff badly needed the good news.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

561119868commit.h: Nebraska beats Ole Miss and Oklahoma for linebacker I. Ahlers
561119868commit.d: [[r:561119868|I. Ahlers]] picked [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] after watching the 34-27 win over [[t:832438320|Iowa]] from the stands. A source says the visit felt like a coronation.

quote.text: That win over Iowa? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

561120909commit.h: Miami lands No. 12 overall J. Nunes on the back of the Syracuse win
561120909commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] added [[r:561120909|J. Nunes]] a short time after beating No. 12 [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. Nunes wanted a power-conference schedule, and a source says the win answered his last question.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561124635commit.h: Ole Miss, the top DL pipeline, adds M. Huntley over Nebraska and Tennessee
561124635commit.d: [[r:561124635|M. Huntley]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], which leads the country in pro potential on the defensive line. A source says the draft-board pitch beat Nebraska and Tennessee's offers.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

561121088commit.h: No. 14 overall D. Mayer picks Notre Dame, citing the head coach
561121088commit.d: [[r:561121088|D. Mayer]] chose [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] after it beat No. 12 [[t:832438398|USC]]. He said the head coach's honesty set the Irish apart, and rival recruiters admit that pitch hit home.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561122197commit.h: Clemson adds No. 15 overall D. Akbar, its second big get this week
561122197commit.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] keeps winning on the trail, landing [[r:561122197|D. Akbar]] after the 50-33 rivalry win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]]. The staff promised him a legitimate shot at starting early.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

561120043commit.h: Ole Miss keeps RB T. Schoonmaker close to home
561120043commit.d: [[r:561120043|T. Schoonmaker]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438288|BYU]]. The short drive from West Monroe mattered to his family, and he cited the Rebels' history of sending backs to the league.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561125659commit.h: Georgia wins five-star tackle K. Withrow, who wants the TV exposure
561125659commit.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] added [[r:561125659|K. Withrow]], a day after a Georgia Tech shootout win that sold the brand. A source says the weekly TV slots were the deciding factor.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561121288commit.h: Miami lands five-star guard D. Spicer, drawn by the spotlight
561121288commit.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] reeled in [[r:561121288|D. Spicer]], a guard who wanted exposure, days after the win over No. 12 [[t:832438380|Syracuse]]. A source says the Hurricanes made a strong brand pitch.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

561120104commit.h: Nebraska lands five-star SAM S. Colon, a power-conference play
561120104commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] keeps stacking its class, adding [[r:561120104|S. Colon]] after the 34-27 win over [[t:832438320|Iowa]]. Colon said he wants a power-conference schedule, and rivals say the Huskers had the hot hand.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561120713commit.h: Nebraska beats the field for five-star tackle C. Bolin
561120713commit.d: [[r:561120713|C. Bolin]] chose [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] because of the head coach's honesty. A source says the coaching staff earned his trust in private conversations, and the Iowa win helped.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

561121426commit.h: Washington lands five-star tackle G. McLane to fill a gaping hole
561121426commit.d: [[t:832438408|Washington]] won the tug-of-war for [[r:561121426|G. McLane]], with [[p:557718138|J.Babcock]] and [[p:557715830|M.Priest]] graduating and the interior line open. A source says he saw a quick path to the field.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561122850commit.h: Nebraska lands five-star TE C. Humphries after the Iowa game convinced him
561122850commit.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] took another big piece in [[r:561122850|C. Humphries]], who liked the brand and the 34-27 win over [[t:832438320|Iowa]]. That makes four significant recent pickups for the Huskers.

quote.text: Watching that Iowa game sealed it for me.

561122631commit.h: Texas gets No. 23 overall Q. Garnes, a defensive back with a pro plan
561122631commit.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] landed [[r:561122631|Q. Garnes]], a top-25 defensive back who liked the Longhorns' history of sending DBs to the NFL. A source says the staff pushed hard after losing Wolf to Texas A&M.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561120670commit.h: It was never close: J. Kindred stays home with Tennessee
561120670commit.d: [[r:561120670|J. Kindred]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] after the 51-10 win over [[t:832438404|Vanderbilt]]. His parents can make every home game, and a source says rivals knew early they were playing for second.

quote.text: Watching that Vanderbilt game sealed it for me.

561121751commit.h: Ole Miss beats Georgia and Alabama for M. Mullins
561121751commit.d: [[r:561121751|M. Mullins]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438312|Georgia]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]], citing conference prestige and the national spotlight. A source says it was a rare miss for the Bulldogs.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561120574commit.h: No. 26 overall R. Liggins stays in Utah with BYU
561120574commit.d: [[r:561120574|R. Liggins]] never seriously considered leaving the state. [[t:832438288|BYU]] closed after beating No. 11 [[t:832438295|Colorado]], and a source says the win erased any doubt.

quote.text: I'm representing Smithfield. Staying close was always the plan.

561122980battle.h: Oklahoma holds the edge for Mohamed, but Tennessee is pushing on playing style
561122980battle.d: Mohamed has said his dealbreaker is how he'll be used. Both staffs know it, and Boise State is quietly hanging around.

quote.text: He wants to know where he fits in the scheme before he cares about anything else.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561120064commit.h: Notre Dame beats Nebraska and Michigan for linebacker K. Johnson
561120064commit.d: [[r:561120064|K. Johnson]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] and [[t:832438339|Michigan]]. The Irish had five linebackers drafted in four years, and the USC win kept the momentum going. Nebraska's staff reportedly thought it was in better shape.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Notre Dame develops linebackers better than anybody.

561121266commit.h: Clemson lands five-star receiver Devey off a rivalry win and a clear path to playing time
561121266commit.d: [[r:561121266|G. Devey]] picked [[t:832438293|Clemson]] after the 50-33 win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]]. Per a source, his family left a recent visit convinced he'd get early reps.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561122068commit.h: TCU lands No. 30 overall Ramsay and clears a path for him in a thin receiver room
561122068commit.d: With [[p:557727364|A.Hajrullahu]] and [[p:557725891|C.Reid]] out of eligibility, [[r:561122068|D. Ramsay]] saw a starting job open at [[t:832438381|TCU]]. The 49-21 win over [[t:832438324|Kansas]] sealed it, per a source close to the program.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

561122364battle.h: Franco's conference-prestige test has Oklahoma in front, with Oregon and Texas in pursuit
561122364battle.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] has the lead for [[r:561122364|J. Franco]], and [[t:832438364|Oregon]] is pushing hard. Texas is still in it, but a source says Longhorns fans are nervous after a rough few weeks.

quote.text: He's said he wants to play in a league that matters in January.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561121524commit.h: Oregon wins a big-brand pitch for No. 31 overall tackle Tobin
561121524commit.d: [[r:561121524|L. Tobin]] wanted national exposure and picked [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. The Ducks also have a hole at tackle with [[p:557718826|B.Bradbury]] and [[p:557717690|J.Reeshad]] leaving. His high school coach says the national spotlight was the whole pitch.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

561121824commit.h: Missouri lands five-star Balogh by selling prestige and playing time
561121824commit.d: [[r:561121824|L. Balogh]] wanted a power-conference stage, and [[t:832438344|Missouri]] offered one with a shot at early snaps. Rival recruiters are reportedly grumbling about the haul.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561119626sign.h: Oklahoma signs five-star corner Wilds, and Texas is left to wonder
561119626sign.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] sold [[r:561119626|W. Wilds]] on a real title shot and got him signed. A source says Texas had been in the mix, which adds to a rough stretch for the Longhorns.

quote.text: He wanted to be on a team that's playing in December.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561121675sign.h: Favre makes it official with Missouri, drawn by the power-conference stage
561121675sign.d: [[r:561121675|I. Favre]] signed with [[t:832438344|Missouri]]. It adds to a strong run for the Tigers, and his family reportedly loved the campus visit.

quote.text: Playing in a power conference was my big thing, and Missouri checked every box.
quote.by: a person close to the family

561125724sign.h: Clemson signs five-star Coburn, strengthening its pitch to the rest of the board
561125724sign.d: [[r:561125724|P. Coburn]] joins [[t:832438293|Clemson]] after the rivalry win over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]]. With fellow top recruit Akbar already in the fold, Clemson's staff is reportedly using the pair to recruit others.

quote.text: When two guys like that pick you, other recruits listen.

557727076:breakout.h: Safety Hewitt's jump has Tennessee's collective bracing for a raise
557727076:breakout.d: [[p:557727076|T.Hewitt]] grew into a 76-overall safety and now makes 75K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the deep pockets to keep him, but rival collectives have noticed.

quote.text: Guys like that don't stay at that number for long.

557728394:breakout.h: Freshman safety Egboh is suddenly a 77, and Auburn's NIL math just got harder
557728394:breakout.d: [[p:557728394|L.Egboh]] jumped to 77 overall and makes only 20K at [[t:832438281|Auburn]]. Collectives elsewhere are starting to look.

quote.text: That's a freshman who could start for a lot of teams tomorrow.

557725065:breakout.h: Freshman tackle Taliaferro is a 80 now, and Florida State needs a bigger offer
557725065:breakout.d: [[p:557725065|A.Taliaferro]] already makes 100K at [[t:832438310|Florida State]], but after climbing to 80 overall, rival collectives are reportedly curious.

quote.text: He's a freshman playing like a veteran. Everyone's checking in.

557724450:breakout.h: Notre Dame's Slaughter is a 79, and his 60K salary looks light
557724450:breakout.d: [[p:557724450|D.Slaughter]] has been one of the best freshman safeties in the country. [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has the NIL muscle to keep him, though a source says other collectives are circling.

quote.text: Notre Dame can afford him, but they'll have to act soon.

557714761:breakout.h: Washington's Cleveland is surging, and so is the question of what he costs
557714761:breakout.d: [[p:557714761|M.Cleveland]] earns nothing in NIL while running backs near his level command real money. [[t:832438408|Washington]] has a decision to make before other schools call.

quote.text: If Washington doesn't take care of him, someone else will.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557716795:fit.h: Penn State's ground game ranks 135th, and Stockton may want out
557716795:fit.d: An 82-overall contact seeker, [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] is stuck in a system near the bottom nationally in rushing. Per a source, it's become a topic in the locker room.

quote.text: He wants to run the ball, and right now nobody can.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719266:underpaid.h: Tennessee guard Trueblood is playing like a star and earning nothing
557719266:underpaid.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is an 89-overall guard with no NIL deal, while comparable players earn around 90K. Tennessee can afford to fix that, but rival collectives are already sniffing around.

quote.text: An 89 making nothing? That doesn't last.

557718961:underpaid.h: Oregon State's Horan is a quarterback somebody will pay for
557718961:underpaid.d: [[p:557718961|D.Horan]] is an 85-overall quarterback making 50K. [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] ranks 101st in NIL spending, so a bidding war is not something it can win.

quote.text: Oregon State won't be able to keep up if a big collective calls.

557712076:sinking.h: Penn State tackle Peter would be the portal's biggest prize if he leaves
557712076:sinking.d: [[p:557712076|B.Peter]] is an 88-overall tackle on a 4-8 team. If he hits the portal, he'd draw a crowd, and agerm40's offseason gets harder.

quote.text: Any contender would pay for a tackle like that.

557720821:buried.h: Running back Zinger is too good to sit, and a move looks likely
557720821:buried.d: [[p:557720821|K.Zinger]] is an 89-overall junior running back with only 178 snaps in 13 games. Teams in the portal market would hand him the job, and a source says he's listening.

quote.text: He wants to be the guy somewhere.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557712277:underpaid.h: Minnesota's Etheridge is a bargain at 15K, and rivals know it
557712277:underpaid.d: [[p:557712277|O.Etheridge]] is an 87-overall corner making 15K, far below the going rate. [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] has a window to fix that before the portal opens.

quote.text: Minnesota is getting a great deal on him, and everyone knows it.

557727075:sinking.h: Georgia Tech's 4-8 year makes receiver Westerman one of the portal's top targets
557727075:sinking.d: [[p:557727075|J.Westerman]] is a 91-overall junior receiver on a 4-8 team, and every contender knows his name. Per a source, the calls have already started.

quote.text: He's too good to be stuck on a team like that.
